verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms FireHydrant serves an llms.txt at docs.firehydrant.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a documentation index. Docs pages are also available as raw Markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or a full page index), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
